I found nothing to flag. Every claim in the overview matches the record. A few details:

- **Who was affected:** the overview says "shoppers", not "all shoppers", which follows the cause's wording.
- **"Lasting fix":** this is just a description of the draft pull request (PR #566), not a new fact.
- **"Not approved or applied yet":** this rests on three lines of the record. The fix was opened as a draft, the record says "nothing ran its fix", and it holds nothing about the pull request after that.
